title: ModelScore
description: What one model produces for one match. This is the system's only score truth: it is stored append-only and never modified. Calibrated and composed scores are derived from these at read time and are never stored as authoritative data.

model_id.description: Stable for the lifetime of the model. Never changes, even when the model is rewritten.

model_version.description: Incremented whenever the model produces different output for unchanged input. A refactor that preserves output may leave it unchanged.

raw_score.description: On the model's own native scale — a probability, a z-score, an arbitrary index. Deliberately unconstrained. Models MUST NOT normalise; the platform percentile-ranks raw scores within a caller-chosen cohort to produce comparable values. Two models' raw scores are not comparable to each other.

components.description: Named factors that drove the score, for explanation. A bare number is a thing to distrust; this is what makes a score arguable.

snapshot_hash.description: Hash of the exact MatchSnapshot this score was computed from. Together with model_id and model_version, this makes any stored score reproducible.
